name: Analyze EUR/USD and read the decision
covers: GET /api/meta market clock and KPI cards
description: Verifies a live analysis returns one decision with its reasons, a drawn chart and the market clock.
expected: The signal card shows a decision of BUY, SELL or NO TRADE with a 'Why' list containing at least one reason, a candlestick chart is drawn in the Chart panel, and the header shows the market clock reading 'FX open' or 'FX closed'.

name: Run the three-agent desk on a reading
description: Verifies the agent desk runs its AI agents on the current reading and shows each agent's verdict and a final decision.
steps: Select 'EUR/USD' in the Market dropdown and click 'Analyze'
In the Agent desk section, click 'Run agent desk'
Wait for the agents to finish
expected: The Agent desk shows a final banner reading TAKE or SKIP, and three agent panels titled Market Analyst, Risk Manager and Head Trader each show a verdict label. The Market Analyst panel lists at least one tool it used, such as get_setup.

name: Run the scanner and read the agent activity and forward test
description: Verifies the scanner runs on demand, reports in the agent activity feed, and the forward-test stats are shown.
expected: After running the scanner a status line starting with 'Scanned' or 'The scanner ran' is visible and the activity list contains an entry starting with 'Scanner:'. The Performance tab shows 'Closed trades', 'Win rate' and 'Average R'.

name: Save a reading, keep it after reload, then delete it
description: Verifies a reading saved by the user survives a reload and a confirmed delete removes it for good.
steps: Select 'EUR/USD' in the Market dropdown and click 'Analyze'
On the EUR/USD 15m entry marked 'You', click its delete (trash) button and then 'Confirm delete'
expected: After the first refresh the Signal log shows a EUR/USD 15m entry marked 'You'. After the confirmed delete and the second refresh that entry marked 'You' is no longer in the Signal log.

name: Size a position and block an invalid stop
description: Verifies the position sizer returns the correct lots for a USD account and rejects a stop equal to the entry.
steps: Set Entry to 1.10000, Stop to 1.09800, Target to 1.10400, Account to 10000, Risk % to 1 and Leverage to 30
expected: After the first calculation the result shows 0.50 lots with Loss at stop $100.00 and Gain at target $200.00. After the second calculation an error reading 'The stop cannot equal the entry' is visible.
